title: Coronavirus Economic Response Package Amendment (Ending Jobkeeper Profiteering) Bill 2021
short_title: Coronavirus Economic Response Package Amendment (Ending Jobkeeper Profiteering) Bill 2021

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would defer goods and services tax input credits for certain larger JobKeeper recipients and require public reporting of their payments and voluntary repayments.
The deferral would apply where a covered recipient made a profit, paid shareholders dividends or paid an executive bonus during a financial year receiving JobKeeper.
Input credits would be delayed for ten years unless the entity earlier made a voluntary payment meeting the bill's repayment calculation and notified the Commissioner.
changes: Published information would identify covered recipients by name and Australian business number.
The public listing would show each covered recipient's total JobKeeper funding.
Details and dates of voluntary repayments would also be published.
Entities ending a deferral early would have to notify the Commissioner in writing of the payment amount and date.
summary.affected: Covered larger JobKeeper recipients and the Commissioner of Taxation are affected.
